I’m focused on building tech that makes healthcare more accessible and efficient. At VitaTech Solutions, I work on full-stack solutions that bridge digital innovation with patient care. My goal is to create systems that simplify complex processes without losing the human touch—whether it’s streamlining provider workflows or enhancing patient engagement.  

As a full-stack developer at VitaTech Solutions, I collaborate across teams to turn ideas into scalable, user-centered products. Recently, I led the integration of a GraphQL-driven API to unify disparate health data sources, improving data consistency across platforms. I also contributed to a React-based dashboard that cut administrative task time by 25% for clinical teams. These projects highlight my commitment to solving real-world problems through code.  

I’m always looking to collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what’s possible in healthtech. Whether it’s refining backend architectures with Node.js and PostgreSQL or exploring new ways to leverage Python for data analysis, I’m driven by the potential to create meaningful impact. Let’s build something that matters.
